scope: Targeted comparison of published briefs and selected papers, not an exhaustive novelty or patent search. Events are external precedents, not Oxford partners. Interpretations and Oxford adaptations are proposals.

events.name: ImmunOS × Pillar VC Assay-A-Thon
events.status: Published event brief for 6–8 November 2026; outcomes not verified in this review.
events.requested: Three published themes: validate designed proteins, prototype assay hardware, and connect molecular measurements with functional biology.
events.outputs: The published brief describes prototype assessment and follow-up validation. The supplied opening deck gives protein-triage, hardware and functional-omics examples; these are proposed projects, not reported successes.
events.overlap: Protein validation overlaps our binding brief; assay hardware and paired functional measurements were not separate tasks in our catalogue.
events.decision: Expand the binding brief; add two cancer-specific assay concepts. Treat negative-result capture as a work package in the existing harmonisation challenge.

events.name: TESLA neoantigen prediction consortium
events.format: Shared-data prediction challenge with experimental testing
events.requested: Teams ranked candidate neoantigens from common tumour/normal sequencing, RNA and HLA information; selected predictions were assessed using patient-matched T-cell evidence.
events.outputs: Ranked peptide–HLA predictions and experimental comparison of immunogenicity.
events.overlap: Direct precedent for our already-listed vaccine epitope family; a generic re-run would repeat an established task.
events.decision: Retain one vaccine family. Scope a new disease setting, cohort or HLA question and a prospective assay budget, then compare with existing baselines.

events.name: IMMREP25: TCR specificity
events.format: Community benchmark on unseen peptide–HLA complexes
events.requested: Predict TCR specificity for peptide–HLA complexes absent from public TCR binding data.
events.outputs: Scores for receptor–target pairs; the organiser described a per-peptide partial-AUC evaluation.
events.overlap: Adjacent to vaccine target selection. It predicts receptor specificity rather than choosing tumour epitopes for a patient.
events.decision: Use as an overlapping benchmark to check before proposing a TCR subtask; keep the vaccine brief focused on its clinical owner’s target-selection decision.

events.name: CASP–DREAM TAP: T-cell activation
events.status: Official Synapse overview read in the browser: registration open; challenge planned to begin January 2027. No results assessed.
events.requested: Classify whether a TCR–peptide–MHC combination activates a T cell, using functional assay labels.
events.outputs: Activation predictions across a shared benchmark with multiple peptide and class-I MHC contexts.
events.overlap: A close active overlap if Oxford frames a generic TCR activation competition. Activation and binding are distinct endpoints.
events.decision: Do not add another general activation benchmark. Explore collaboration or a specifically justified cancer-vaccine cohort and decision.

events.name: Anthropic × Adaptyv: KRAS pMHC binder design
events.status: Published 2026 task; reviewed as a brief, not as evidence of completed validation.
events.requested: Design a binder selective for mutant KRAS G12D peptide–HLA over the wild-type complex and peptide-free HLA.
events.outputs: Protein designs evaluated for target binding and counter-target specificity.
events.overlap: Related cancer immunity context, but the target peptide is already specified. This differs from selecting vaccine epitopes.
events.decision: Borrow explicit counter-controls and agreed validation; do not label vaccine epitope ranking as an identical binder-design task.

events.name: GEM × Adaptyv: RBX-1 binder design
events.format: Cancer-relevant target competition with laboratory testing
events.status: Published 2026 rules; actual results not reviewed here.
events.requested: Submit ranked de novo binders for RBX-1 and a short method description, for organiser-led expression and binding measurements.
events.outputs: A ranked sequence list; the brief described shared experimental capacity and reference controls.
events.overlap: A precedent for the existing protein-binding theme, not a new Oxford challenge by itself.
events.decision: Keep one binding-and-validation brief, with a new clinical or biological endpoint only if an owner and assay partner can support it.

events.name: Anti–PD-1 Response Prediction DREAM Challenge
events.format: Model-to-data evaluation using protected clinical trials
events.requested: Predict immunotherapy clinical outcomes, with models evaluated inside protected trial-data environments and assessed on a further trial.
events.outputs: Containerised prediction models, clinical outcome comparisons and evaluation of generalisability.
events.overlap: Direct precedent for our existing immunotherapy-response example; the general question is already established.
events.decision: Retain the current brief, requiring a defined cancer setting, independent evidence and a clearly justified extension rather than duplicating this benchmark.

supplied_deck.name: Assay-A-Thon Opening Deck
supplied_deck.local_source: Assay-A-Thon Opening Deck_files/saved_resource.html (user-supplied saved HTML, outside the site repository)
supplied_deck.verification: 25-slide saved deck read locally; public Claude link remained access-blocked. Reviewed examples and hypotheses, not project outcomes. Raw deck and third-party assets are not republished.
supplied_deck.slides: Protein examples: 10–11. Hardware examples: 13–15. Functional omics examples: 17–18.

examples.name: Binder-Sieve
examples.task: Triage designed binder pools using inexpensive experimental evidence.
examples.decision: Work package in the existing binding-and-validation brief.

examples.name: Synapse-Switch
examples.task: Compare binding with an immune-cell functional endpoint.
examples.decision: Functional validation work package in the same binding brief.

examples.name: Trust-Curve
examples.task: Calibrate a model confidence score against measurements.
examples.decision: Calibration work package, not a separate challenge.

examples.name: Fail-Forward
examples.task: Record failed expression, solubility and binding outcomes.
examples.decision: Add an assay-evidence work package to the existing harmonisation brief.

examples.name: Cell/tissue confinement, transfer and flow capture
examples.task: Prototype reproducible cell positioning, movement or capture and readouts.
examples.decision: New cancer-specific assay-prototyping concept; choose one device task, not all at once.

examples.name: Morpho-Seq
examples.task: Connect a measured morphological response to molecular profiling.
examples.decision: Optional work package in one functional-omics challenge.

examples.name: Perturb-Kill-Seq
examples.task: Connect perturbation-associated immune killing with molecular identity.
examples.decision: Alternative work package in the same functional-omics challenge.

examples.name: Syn-Secretome
examples.task: Connect a secretion phenotype with molecular profiling.
examples.decision: Alternative work package in the same functional-omics challenge.

examples.name: Spatial-Stim-Seq
examples.task: Connect a local tissue response with spatial molecular measurements.
examples.decision: Alternative work package in the same functional-omics challenge.
